page_title: UDI 3-0 BOL | Udinese v Bologna 30/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' None of the Bologna players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

90+5' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. Maduka Okoye pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.

90+5' Martin Payero (Udinese) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Daniele Orsato blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
90+4' The ball is cleared after Isaac Success (Udinese) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90+3' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) tries to put the rebound into the net from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper pulls off a good save to deny him.
90+2' Isaac Success (Udinese) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.

90+1' What a chance that is! Michel Aebischer (Bologna) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
90+1' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna), whose header goes wide of the goal.
87' Here is a change. Hassane Kamara is going off and Gabriele Cioffi gives the last tactical orders to Adam Masina (Udinese).
87' Isaac Success (Udinese) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lorenzo Lucca.
83' Referee Daniele Orsato has finally had enough of Thiago Motta and gives him a straight RED CARD!
82' Martin Payero (Udinese) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
80' It is time for a substitution. Walace is on for Roberto Pereyra (Udinese).
80' Gabriele Cioffi prepares a substitution. Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) is replaced by Florian Thauvin.

79' Martin Payero (Udinese) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
76' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) picks up the rebound just a few yards out of the box. He attempts to beat the goalkeeper with a fine shot, but the goalkeeper is on hand to deny him.
75' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) picked up a yellow card from referee.
74' That will be all from Kacper Urbanski who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Sydney van Hooijdonk (Bologna).
73' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
72' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) receives a yellow card.

71' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Maduka Okoye makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom right corner.
70' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
70' Substitution. Festy Ebosele makes his way off the pitch and Oier Zarraga (Udinese) comes on as his replacement.
69' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
68' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Udinese win a corner.
67' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
66' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
65' Udinese failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
63' That's a clear yellow card. Remo Freuler (Bologna) goes into the book.
61' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) takes the corner kick, but Lukasz Skorupski reads it well and stops the effort.

61' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. It will be a corner kick for Udinese.
60' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
59' A goal, which was scored by Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese), was disallowed due to offside.
58' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
56' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) will replace Alexis Saelemaekers.
56' Thiago Motta has decided to substitute Victor Kristiansen and he is replaced by Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna).
55' It will be a substitution. Michel Aebischer (Bologna) is ready to enter the pitch as Nikola Moro walks off.
55' That's the end of the game for Stefan Posch, who is replaced by Jhon Lucumi (Bologna).
55' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Udinese will take a corner kick.
54' The linesman points to the corner flag, Udinese are going to take it.
52' 3 - 0 Martin Payero (Udinese) has reason to celebrate! His first-time shot from the edge of the area goes into the middle of the net and past the goalkeeper. 3:0.
52' Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Daniele Orsato blows his whistle for an infringement.
51' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
48' 2 - 0 Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) latches on to a superb pass and breaks through the defence before firing a shot from mid-range that goes past the goalkeeper inside the right post.
47' A raking crossfield pass from Stefan Posch (Bologna) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession. The ball is out of play. Bologna will take a throw-in.
46' A player from Bologna commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) whips in a cross from the corner, but Maduka Okoye is well positioned and punches the ball away.
45+4' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Bologna will take a corner.
45+3' What was Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
45+3' Stefan Posch (Bologna) sends a cross in and finds Kacper Urbanski inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
45+2' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) is cautioned and receives a yellow card.
45+2' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' The corner from Remo Freuler (Bologna) is hurriedly cleared.
45' Maduka Okoye leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna). The ball is out of play and Bologna manage to earn a corner.
44' Stefan Posch (Bologna) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
43' 22:78 – the latest ball possession ratio.

42' Martin Payero (Udinese) picks the ball up and blasts it from long range without any hesitation. His shot is directed towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper reads it well and makes a fine save.
41' Udinese will look to take advantage of a free kick in a promising position in the middle of the field.
41' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Lorenzo Lucca, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
39' Nikola Moro (Bologna) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
38' It wasn't the best example of how to strike the ball. Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) unleashed a first-time shot from the edge of the box that went high over the crossbar.
37' Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) leaps highest to connect with the corner, but aims his close-range header well wide of the right post.
35' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
33' Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
33' Bologna keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
30' Udinese take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
29' Martin Payero (Udinese) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
28' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) sends a long ball forward to Kacper Urbanski, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
26' The Bologna players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
23' 1 - 0 Goal! Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 1:0.
23' The resulting corner from Sandi Lovric (Udinese) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
23' A neat pass is well received by Festy Ebosele (Udinese), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
20' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Daniele Orsato blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Bologna are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
16' Joao Ferreira (Udinese) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
15' Udinese have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
13' Looks like Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
11' Nikola Moro (Bologna) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
10' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) trips an opposition player and Daniele Orsato signals a foul. Bologna have a free kick.
9' Nikola Moro (Bologna) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
7' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Udinese, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
6' Yellow card. Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
5' Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
1' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) sends a chip pass into the box, but Lukasz Skorupski is quickest to intercept the ball.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Udinese will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Daniele Orsato.
